codes.evidence_quote: «Mi tesis es esta: de no haber existido el pueblo gitano, no tendríamos cante flamenco».
codes.target: Arrebola's gitano-andaluz thesis about the origins of cante flamenco
codes.rationale: The passage frames flamenco origins through an identity group claim in which the pueblo gitano becomes constitutive of cante flamenco.

codes.evidence_quote: apoyado en estudios anteriores y a los que se suma la inexcusable valía de la práctica profesional del cante
codes.target: Arrebola's book and its basis of authority
codes.rationale: The review legitimates the book's claims through prior scholarship and the author's practical professional knowledge of cante.
